title: A main pipeline is read by its gate jobs: an unrun gate is unverified, a failed script is red
goal: ql_deliver.job_verdict reads a GitLab pipeline's job list: red when a job's script failed (status failed, failure_reason script_failure), pending when a gate job (GATE_JOBS: kb-tests, kb-trailers) is unfinished, unverified when a gate job is manual, skipped, canceled, failed without running or missing, else ok; backlog.py red-pipeline reads the newest finished or manual pipeline of main by it (--status exits 1 on unverified and names each gate job that did not pass; filing files nothing for it) and ql_deliver.ci_pipeline gives apply --push the verdict unverified, which pushes nothing that run; kb/_self/backlog.md, querylog.md and tools.md say so; test_red_pipeline_unrun_gate_is_not_green and TestJobVerdict plant each state from recorded job lists
